description: Two wavefolders that fold or wrap whatever goes past the edges of a voltage window back inside it, each giving the result and the result of the inverted input

params.text: Sets how tall the window is, 0.5V to 10V, the window being centred on the Height setting
Moves the centre of the window, -5V to 5V
Bends the result inside the window, -0.99 for nearly logarithmic through 0 for untouched to 0.99 for exponential
Switches that half between folding what goes past an edge back in and wrapping it round to the far edge

inputs.text: The signal to fold; with no cable this half gets 0V
The signal to fold; with no cable this half takes whatever the other Signal jack carries
The absolute value of the voltage is added to the Frame knob, the total clamped to 0.5V and 10V
Added to the Height knob, the total clamped to -5V and 5V
Divided by 5 and added to the Bend knob, the total clamped to -0.99 and 0.99

outputs.text: The folded signal, always inside the window
The folded signal with the input inverted first, always inside the window

notes: the window runs from the Height setting minus half the Frame setting to the Height setting plus half of it, so Frame at 10 and Height at 0 leaves everything between -5V and 5V untouched
folding and wrapping are applied over and over until the result lands inside the window, but no more than ten times, so an input far enough outside a narrow window can come out beyond its edges
every jack is monophonic, whatever is patched in
